responsibility: Implements GraphViz .dot rendering for analyzer-style diagnostic state graphs. Building on diagnostics::state_graphs metadata layered over generic digraphs, this file interprets memory-region node kinds, dynamic-allocation states, logical stack-frame names, and edge endpoints to synthesize a richly structured dot::graph with subgraphs, HTML-table nodes, ports, labels, and color coding suitable for visualizing program state at a diagnostic event.
